sections.heading: Compute detection precision and recall from a confusion matrix
sections.command: Paper calculation: TP=8; FP=2; FN=4; TN=86
sections.instruction: Objective: interpret the command or evidence first, predict the observable result, then compare the observation against the expected outcome. Record both what the evidence supports and what it cannot establish. If recall is calculated using FP, recheck the denominator: recall counts actual positive cases TP+FN, while precision counts predicted positives TP+FP.
sections.interpretation: Precision = TP/(TP+FP) = 8/10 = 80%; recall = TP/(TP+FN) = 8/12 ≈ 66.7%. Accuracy = 94/100 = 94%; high accuracy can mask missed malicious events.
